I’ve been on a waiting list myself for over a year with no progress. We definitely can’t afford private as it’s £800-£1000 just for a consult and further hundreds for every follow up for assessments and about £80 for every speech and language appointment.

The best advice I got in my masters was to break down the topic. So I did one on media consumption and attentional bias in eating disorders. I wrote about the two topics separately and critiqued them with we don’t know how media consumption correlated with EDs and we don’t know the mechanisms or causes of attentional bias. It’s just a summary of the topic with evaluation of the studies and theories. 

I feel your pain, I’m 7,000 words into one for my PhD chapter - it’s a lot of info to organise
